note: Confirmed gear-reward quests worth doing before the cap. Reward stats/equip levels verified via Wowhead Classic item data (equip level <=19). xpWarning marks turn-ins that grant enough XP to risk pushing a near-cap character to 20 — do these before syncing to 19.

quests.name: The Night Watch

reward.desc: Choice of ammo bag — Quiver of the Night Watch (arrows) or Bandolier of the Night Watch (bullets), or Gunnysack of the Night Watch (10-slot general bag). Ammo bags have no equip requirement.

quests.notes: End of the Commander Althea Ebonlocke chain in Darkshire (Duskwood). The quiver/bandolier benefit ranged users (hunter especially; also warrior/rogue with a ranged weapon). Duskwood quests grant significant XP. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic.

quests.name: In Nightmares

reward.desc: Talbar Mantle — cloth shoulders, Requires Level 10: +6 Intellect, +3 Stamina (30 armor). A caster shoulder pick.

quests.notes: Quest 3369; end of a Barrens chain turned in to Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise (Thunder Bluff). Level-25 quest — large XP turn-in. Talbar Mantle is one reward choice and is equippable at 19 (req 10). Confirmed via Wowhead Classic (item 10657).

quests.name: Bloodfury Bloodline

reward.desc: Screecher Belt — leather waist, Requires Level 18: +5 Intellect, +2 Spirit, +3 Stamina, +12 Attack Power (50 armor). Hybrid AP/int belt.

quests.notes: Quest 6283; from Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat (Stonetalon Mountains). Level-26 quest — substantial XP turn-in. Screecher Belt is Horde-only and equippable at 19 (req 18). Confirmed via Wowhead Classic (item 16987).
